conceptPrompt:
Invent ONE brand-new Singapore/Malaysian hawker-food spirit FAMILY for the game Hawker Hunt.
It must be a real or highly plausible hawker dish, turned into a cute collectible monster family of 3 evolution stages.
Design goals: every dish must be UNIQUE (no collision with existing pets); may resemble the style but never be identical.
No specific direction — free creative choice.

Return JSON with: seriesId (ascii kebab-case, unique), foodOrigin {en,zh}, element (one of metal/wood/water/fire/earth), flavor (one of bitter/sour/salty/sweet/spicy per 五行五味), and stages: an array of EXACTLY 3 objects each { id (ascii kebab-case, unique per stage), stage (1|2|3), name{en,zh}, description{en,zh}, theme, skillIdeas[] }.
Keep every stage consistent with this art DNA: Chibi anthropomorphic Singapore hawker-food creature mascot, big expressive cartoon eyes, rounded soft chunky body, thick painterly cartoon shading (not flat vector, not realistic), warm friendly collectible-monster design, full body head-to-toe, standing, slight 3/4 front view facing camera, cohesive with a unified collectible set of food spirits.


DO NOT duplicate any of these already-used dishes or names (you MAY be stylistically similar, but the dish, the name and the id MUST be distinct and unique):
Dishes: Hainanese Chicken Rice, 海南雞飯, Laksa, 叻沙, Bak Kut Teh, 肉骨茶, Kueh Lapis, 九層糕, Kaya Toast, 咖椰吐司, Chilli Crab, 辣椒蟹, Satay, 沙嗲, Kopi O, 咖啡烏, Chai Tow Kway, 菜頭粿, Rojak, 囉喏, Oyster Omelette, 蠔煎, Char Kway Teow, 炒粿條, Curry Puff, 咖喱卜, Roti Prata, 印度煎餅, Chendol, 煎蕊, Chilli Padi, 辣椒, Garlic, 蒜頭, Lemongrass, 香茅, Rice Ball, 飯團, Rice Vermicelli, 米粉, Egg, 雞蛋, Fresh Shrimp, 鮮蝦, Coconut Milk, 椰漿, Kueh Tutu, 嘟嘟糕

description.en: Concentrated essence of Nasi Lemak, fuel for evolution.
description.zh: 濃縮嘅椰漿飯精華，進化嘅燃料。

description.en: A tiny, fragrant lump of coconut rice wrapped snugly in a fresh banana leaf diaper. It toddles around with a single crispy anchovy on its head, spreading a gentle aroma of sweet pandan.
description.zh: 一個散發著椰香的小米飯團，裹在溫馨的芭蕉葉尿布中。它頭上戴著一條香脆的江魚仔，走起路來搖搖晃晃，散發出淡淡的斑蘭清香。

stages.theme: Chibi coconut rice baby wrapped in a banana leaf diaper with an anchovy hair clip.

description.en: Outfitted for backyard adventures, this chubby rice spirit wears a hard-boiled egg slice as a protective helmet and carries a crisp cucumber shield. It is beginning to master the warm, fiery kick of sweet sambal.
description.zh: 裝備齊全的胖嘟嘟冒險小兵，戴著半顆水煮蛋做成的頭盔，手持一片清脆的小黃瓜盾牌。它已經開始學會掌控參巴辣椒醬的溫暖熱力。

stages.theme: Chubby rice warrior with an egg-slice helmet, cucumber shield, and a smear of sambal paint.

description.en: The grand defender of the morning markets, draped in a majestic, flowing banana leaf cape. It wields a mighty golden-fried chicken wing as a sword and commands the deep, rich volcano of savory-sweet sambal.
description.zh: 晨間巴剎與熟食中心的偉大捍衛者，身披威武的芭蕉葉斗篷。它手握一隻金黃酥脆的炸雞翅神劍，能召喚出濃郁香辣的參巴火山狂潮。

stages.theme: Majestic chibi general with a flowing banana leaf cape, golden chicken wing sword, and glowing red sambal markings.

description.en: A tiny, fragrant lump of coconut rice wrapped snugly in a fresh banana leaf diaper. It toddles around with a single crispy anchovy on its head, spreading a gentle aroma of sweet pandan.

concept.theme: Chibi coconut rice baby wrapped in a banana leaf diaper with an anchovy hair clip.

description.en: Releases a sweet, soothing aroma of coconut and pandan that disorients opponents while dealing light damage.
description.zh: 釋放出香甜誘人的椰香斑蘭氣味，迷惑對手並造成輕微傷害。

description.en: Charges forward with a crunchy, hard-hitting headbutt powered by a dried anchovy.
description.zh: 以爽脆堅硬的江魚仔奮力向前一撞，痛擊前方敵人。

description.en: Slams enemies with a cool, thick cucumber slice that also dampens incoming attacks.
description.zh: 用清涼厚實的青瓜片猛擊對手，同時抵擋迎面而來的攻勢。

description.en: Splashes spicy, aromatic sambal chili to inflict continuous burning damage on foes.
description.zh: 潑灑香辣惹味的參巴辣椒醬，對敵人造成持續的灼燒傷害。

description.en: Slashes through enemy lines with razor-sharp, golden-fried chicken wing blades.
description.zh: 揮舞利如刀刃的金黃酥脆炸雞翼，無情地橫掃敵陣。

description.en: Unleashes a devastating geyser of fiery sambal chili that scorches the entire battlefield.
description.zh: 引爆火山般的烈焰參巴醬，用極致的辛辣火舌吞噬戰場。
